verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim scoped OAuth tokens, minimal permissions, encrypted secrets, and automatic key rotation with audit logs, directly matching the least-privilege credential story. However this is vendor-only documentation with no independent verification, API reference, or technical detail on how scoping is configured. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation, technical API/credential documentation (openapi/llms.txt probes both 404), and detail on how a user actually issues/configures scoped credentials.
